 Miller, Greg David. Dearly loved brother and brother in law of Anne and Wayne Cavaye, Raewyn and the late Kevin Heywood, Caryll and the late Denis Ridings and James Miller. As a result of a tragic accident. Devasting loss for us all. Rest in love Bro. To plant trees in memory, please visit the  Sympathy Store .
